build_cpp_ast_from_source: build an AST from C++ source code using BuilderFromSource and iterate over nodes with Generate
parse_cpp_identifiers: parse a C++ file and print all identifiers matching a predicate using PrintIndentifiers
parse_multiple_cpp_files: parse multiple C++ source files and print identifiers using PrintAllIndentifiers
convert_tokens_to_type: convert a list of C++ tokens into Type AST nodes using TypeConverter.ToType
convert_tokens_to_parameters: convert a list of C++ tokens into Parameter AST nodes using TypeConverter.ToParameters
